highlights.title: Home stats banner uses fixed 180 mg/dL bound
changes: The Home stats banner now uses a fixed 180 mg/dL upper bound.
The banner now matches the Stats screen's Time-in-Range numbers.
Your High Glucose chart threshold no longer changes the banner's upper bound.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1421: Use fixed consensus TIR bound in home stats banner

highlights.title: Stable contact image backgrounds
changes: You can pick a background for contact images (Transparent or Black) in the contact image editor.
Choosing Black prevents contact images from randomly switching between white and black backgrounds.
Transparent background preserves image transparency while Black fills the image area with solid black.
Your chosen background is saved with each contact image and restored when shown.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1427: fix for contact backgrounds having unstable background colours

highlights.title: Unified device picker and pump-based basal steps
changes: Device selection now uses a single grouped picker with manufacturer sections and device icons.
CGM hint lists no longer show unreachable entries like Dexcom Share and FreeStyle Libre Demo.
Onboarding and therapy settings use pump-provided basal increments; Dana now offers 0.01 steps and zero is excluded.
Device icons are resolved from each kit's bundled artwork, with a category glyph fallback for missing assets.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1439: Introduce Device Catalog, Refactor Device Pickers and Use Pump-Derived Basal Increments
Add grouped device picker backed by a static catalog
Derive onboarding basal limits from the pump kits

highlights.title: Eversense CGM update and fixes
changes: Trio can now upload Eversense data to non-US servers.
Trend arrows on E3 sensors display correctly.
Calibration countdown on E3 sensors works correctly.
Eversense sensor insertion dates are uploaded if missing.
Error 255 is hidden and E3 alert history display is fixed.

highlights.title: Glass-styled action sheets replace confirmations
changes: Confirmation dialogs across the app now open as a bottom glass-style action sheet instead of the system popover.
Sheets use a frosted “Liquid Glass” panel appearance with a bold, detached Cancel button.
When Reduce Transparency is enabled the sheets fall back to opaque panels and a stronger dim behind them.
Action labels are localized correctly and dynamic names are shown verbatim where needed.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1393: Introduce Custom Liquid Glass-Styled Action Sheet as Confirmation Dialog Replacement

includedPullRequests.title: fix for contact backgrounds having unstable background colours
includedPullRequests.body: Over the last while I've noticed that the contacts on my Apple Watch would randomly switch between white and black backgrounds. White backgrounds stick out a lot and make it hard to read the values too. This PR fixes it by simply setting the background to black. I've run this with my setup for 2-ish days now and have not seen any ill effects. The fix applies to the top and left most circular complications on this screenshot:

includedPullRequests.title: Introduce Device Catalog, Refactor Device Pickers and Use Pump-Derived Basal Increments
includedPullRequests.body: ## Summary Consolidates CGM and pump metadata into one `DeviceCatalog`, and replaces the four hardcoded `confirmationDialog`s with a single grouped picker sheet. **Why:** adding a CGM meant editing four hand-synced lists; a pump, seven. They had already drifted — `cgmOptions` advertised "Dexcom Share" and "FreeStyle Libre Demo", which matched nothing and could never be selected. **No submodule changes.** Trio links the kits statically, so the picker reads each kit's existing artwork via `Bundle(identifier:)` rather than needing `pickerImage` added upstream (LoopKit#604 et al. — 17 PRs across 15 repos, all still open). Also **fixes #1413**: the onboarding Pump Model selector never changed the basal increments — every option used a hardcoded 0.05 step. Bounds now come from each kit's `onboardingSupportedBasalRates`, so Dana gets its real 0.01. Zero is excluded there and in therapy settings, because oref rejects a schedule containing a 0 rate. ## Screenshots | Pump Options | CGM Options | |--------|-------| | | | | | | ## User-visible - Dexcom Share and FreeStyle Libre Demo no longer appear in the CGM hint list (they were never selectable). - Basal rate minimum is no longer 0, in onboarding and therapy settings. 27 unit tests; four artwork gaps fall back to a category glyph and are pinned by test.
